title: Add an expired document and another tenant's
question: What support does the Pro plan include?
description: The retriever also returns a 2025 SLA whose expires has passed (it says Pro has phone support), a chunk from tenant globex that leaked through a shared index, and a refunds chunk scoring 0.41 against a threshold of 0.6. Each is excluded with the earliest applicable reason code.
proves: Eligibility is the route's predicate, applied outside the model. The stale SLA never reaches the request, so the model cannot repeat it.
